name: tattoo-planner
description: Local 3D preview tool for planning a tattoo sleeve (sketch, not design).

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:build && electron .
scripts.desktop:build: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist-desktop',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json --noEmit false && node scripts/desktop-icon.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --mac --config desktop/electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --dir --config desktop/electron-builder.config.mjs --publish never
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && node scripts/check-binaries.mjs --all
